text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21 the paclitaxel shortage has been on FDA's list for 61 months since the 2021-10-05 posting. Corvale General holds two NDCs: 25021025550 from Sagent Pharmaceuticals (label 5721b9bf) and 46708062117 from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited (label 6d04b514). Corvale East holds the same two NDCs. The Sagent product label names plant GLAND with a sponsor-only link and no FDA inspection classification is provided. The Alembic product label names plant Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited (FEI 3014866088, India) with a registered plant link and a VAI inspection on 2024-03-08 known to FDA on 2024-05-02. Current stock: Corvale East 50 mL SDV 21 units (6 days), 16.7 mL MDV 74 units (32.6 days); Corvale General 81.45 units (26.2 days) and 71.85 units (25.4 days); Corvale Lakeside 50 mL vial 7 units (9.2 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows paclitaxel posted 2021-10-05 and still listed as of 2026-10-21. The Sagent plant GLAND has no FDA inspection classification provided. The Alembic plant FEI 3014866088 had a VAI inspection on 2024-03-08 known to FDA on 2024-05-02.

Our position: Corvale General can spare 4 units while retaining two weeks' supply; Corvale Lakeside would reach 14 days. Corvale East can also spare 4 units while retaining two weeks. Verify Sagent plant GLAND inspection status and confirm Alembic FEI 3014866088 current classification before relying on these sources.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 4 units from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside — needs pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Transfer 4 units from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside — needs pharmacy director (transfer request).
3. Buy from Abraxis BioScience, LLC — needs buyer.
4. Buy from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. — needs buyer.
5. Buy from American Regent, Inc. — needs buyer.

Not recommended: No additional actions at this time.
